videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Part 3: A DNA sample seems to rule out cabbie David Russo of murder - until it transpires a recent blood transfusion that may have affected the result.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Teenage rapist Ross Trescot is brought into custody, but his arrest does little to comfort June, who insists on being interviewed by Sheelagh.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: At the End of a Long Day: Yvonne sets off for Barton Street Station to face formal manslaughter charges but has a run-in with a drunk en route and ends up hitting him.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: June is forced to deal with a date-rape case on her first day back at work, while a concerned Zain discovers Smithy is sleeping with Louise Larson.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Amber is paired up with Honey and sent to find the man responsible for two date-rape incidents, but puts herself at risk trying to catch the suspect.

videos.title: The Bill
videos.description: Yvonne's trial gets under way and Jack is shocked to learn his son Ben may be the mastermind behind a drugs operation.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: The team are called in to save the survivors of a fatal crash and there's a bomb alert after Afghan asylum seekers are moved into a seaside hotel.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: A police pursuit ends in a crash when a car driven by teenage joyriders plunges into a deep ditch. A punter falls through the floor of his local betting shop in a bizarre accident.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: Reality series following the work of Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team. Paramedic Rochers fights to save a DIY mechanic crushed by his own car.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: Reality series following the work of Yorkshire Hazardous Area Response Team. The team try to seal a major chemical spill and help a teenager who fell down a chimney.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: Reality series following Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team. In this edition the team race to save a man who has been shot outside a mosque.

videos.title: 999 Rescue Squad
videos.description: More real-life drama with Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team. The medics are called to support a bomb squad, and help a teenager impaled on a gate.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: The team tackles a dramatic operation where a patient's heart is stopped and restarted. Zoe has a stent replaced in her ureter, which was damaged by her treatment for cancer.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: Trisha has an investigation of her womb to find out if she has cancer, Steve's varicose veins are stripped from his leg, and Dennis needs an operation to strengthen his eyelid.

videos.title: My Family Xmas 2006: The Heart of Xmas
videos.description: Ben would do anything to get out of Christmas at home, while Michael and Alfie make the most of an empty house.

videos.title: My Family Xmas 2007: Ho Ho No
videos.description: A festive edition of the family sitcom from 2007. Ben thinks all his Christmases have come at once when Susan whisks him away to a country retreat, without the kids.

videos.title: My Family Xmas 2008: Have An Unhappy Christmas
videos.description: A festive edition of the family sitcom. Ben's Christmas present for Susan gets him into trouble, and a letter from The Palace means a change of holiday plan.

videos.title: Gavin and Stacey: A Special Christmas
videos.description: Gavin and Stacey's families get together in Wales for Christmas, and meet Smithy's new girlfriend.

videos.title: Sort Your Life Out Special
videos.description: Stacey Solomon and her gang challenge the Yaku family to sort their life out in seven days with a mammoth declutter and discover why their home is making them miserable.

videos.title: Teleshopping
videos.description: Shopping from Home.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Crews from West Midlands Ambulance Service attend a diabetic who has collapsed at home, reassure the wife of a man with heart problems and keep up the spirits of a woman with womb cancer.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: The paramedics treat a young mum with severe stomach pains, take a breathless pensioner to hospital and attend an elderly lady with dementia whose nose will not stop bleeding.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Dudley crews attend a man with heart failure and sepsis, as well as a transgender patient who's in a lot of pain from an old injury. In Stoke, a patient has a panic attack in the ambulance.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: The crews are kept busy attending a man with a swollen leg, a fisherman having a stroke and a teenager whose chest pains turn out to be something totally unexpected.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: In this 100th episode, the crews go cross country after a teenager's bike crash, attend a man who's had a nasty fall and help a woman with end-stage cancer.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Following the West Midlands Ambulance Service during the festive period. Laura and Anna are called to a man who has fallen off a roof and hit his head.

videos.title: Inside the Ambulance
videos.description: Heavy snow in the West Midlands wreaks chaos, and two separate crews treat patients, both called John, who have both broken their hips after falling.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Hugo and The Ice Cream Pups: Pete meets some newborn pups fighting to survive, and helps teach Hugo, a Cane Corso rescued from quarantine at Dover, how to be a dog.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete helps a withdrawn pregnant Malinois regain strength so she can care for her 11 lively pups, and falls for Winter, a Staffie who is covered in scars.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete meets Flower, the first dog ever to take a dislike to him - can he win her trust? He also helps Heidi and Marvin, both facing serious medical challenges.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Coco, Sapphire and the Cheese Chis: Pete helps rescue six Chihuahuas from the home of a hoarder and witnesses the emotional handover of a pregnant pug and her sister.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Nugget, Tetley and the Police Pups: Pete meets Chow Chow Nugget who has a longer stay than planned, three-legged Tetley, and some Belgium Malinois puppies training to be service dogs.

videos.title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake
videos.description: Pete meets Keira, a dog on the brink of starvation, and gentle old Jack Russell Paige, whose owner had to make the heartbreaking decision to give her up after 15 years.

videos.title: The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick
videos.description: Adam, Harvey & Peggy: Sleigh-pulling Alaskan malamute Adam needs both knees replacing with implants. But as he is recovering from one operation, his other knee begins to fail.

videos.title: The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick
videos.description: Maxi, River & Keira: Charity worker Kerry brings in rescue Greyhound Maxi with a severely damaged front legs. Noel's dog Keira is rushed in with with sickness and diarrhoea.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: Teenager Nathan has two twisted teeth extracted, Bob has keyhole surgery for a groin hernia, and 96-year-old Peggy entertains the team while having a growth removed from her toe.

videos.title: Inside the Operating Theatre
videos.description: Jonathan has a camera put inside his lungs to find out if he has cancer. James needs a knee operation so he can play with his children again, and a growth is removed from Jan's ear.
